name: Royals Next Door
summary: The series follows Stella and her royal family, who've been forced to move houses due to water damage in their castle. Queen Kat sees it as the perfect opportunity to modernise. In line with King Bob's royal motto "Closer to the people" they decide to live in a normal house in an ordinary suburb.

name: Stumble
summary: An elite cheerleading coach has her life flipped upside down when she's forced to start over with a new squad of lovable misfits. But to win the championship, they have no choice but to kick it into high cheer.

name: Callan Kicks the Years
summary: Oliver Callan romps through the 100 years since the 1921 Treaty using sketches and satire, retelling the cultural, political, entertainment and sports revolutions of the last century in Ireland.

name: New Year's Eve Live
summary: Ring in the new year live in the intimate surrounds of Dublin Castle with a special guest.

name: Crafty Christmas
summary: Join Ande and Órla at Crafty Christmas HQ.

name: Funny Little Monsters
summary:
The story so far…

Using the latest advances in technology, including directly hot wiring the brains of the nation's children to a state of the art neural network of high performance machine learning computers, was just not possible.

So, we asked them to draw a picture.

On a piece of actual paper. Of a Funny Little Monster. From their imagination.

We asked about their monster. We asked about them.

We threw it in an airfryer for 20 minutes at 206° and this is what came out…

name: Ilary
summary: This documentary series follows TV host Ilary Blasi as she defines her life post-divorce, balancing personal growth, career opportunities and a new love.

name: Cold Case Files: Murder in the Bayou
summary: Narrated by Keith David, "Cold Case Files: Murder In the Bayou" features stories that the swamp threatened to swallow forever, but detectives managed to drag out into the light. These investigators, family, and friends know that no matter how deep in the muck it's buried, no sin stays secret forever.

name: Selling the City
summary: A team of stylishly savvy New York real estate agents hustle to seal multimillion-dollar deals while stirring up drama in this soapy reality series.

name: Ruyi
summary: Ordinary girl Ye Ruyi suddenly finds herself transported into a comic book, only to become a minor side character doomed to fail. Meanwhile, the antagonist Zuo Qianchen inexplicably awakens to self-awareness within the comic's world. From initial mutual suspicion to eventually joining forces to defy their predestined fates, they fight through the obstacles of the comic's rigid storyline, breaking free from its constraints. Through hardship, they find redemption in each other, and the blossoms of friendship and love bloom brightly as they rewrite their destinies together.

name: Animals Like Us
summary: Peek inside the lives of penguins, giraffes, chimps, and other animals that behave a whole lot like humans. Touch down on all seven continents around the world to see why these wild creatures compete, co-operate, love, and grieve just like we do.

name: Volta Priscila
summary: In 2004, Brazil stopped to follow the drama of the family of famous wrestler Vitor Belfort, who, accustomed to the glory of the octagon, was shaken by the disappearance of his sister, the cheerful Priscila. Amid theories and fake evidence, the search for her becomes endless, full of tortuous paths, somber characters and more doubts than answers, in a plot that includes politics, drug trafficking and the media. However, twenty years later, Priscila's real personality could be the key to put an end to this mysterious story.

name: Turtle Academy
summary: In Turtle Academy, two kids meet and then learn amazing skills from real-life pros who are inspired by the Turtles.

name: Our BIG Yorkshire Christmas
summary: Enjoy the glorious Yorkshire landscape in all its wintry, carol-singing splendour.

name: Who Does Christmas Better?!
summary: Christmas special going behind the scenes at the UKs biggest retailers.

previousepisode.name: Aldi vs M&S: Who Does Christmas Better?

name: Milkshake! Hippo Watch
summary: Wildlife presenter Steve Backshall is on an adventure to find out all about hippos in South Africa.

name: Fresh vs Frozen: Which Is Better?
summary: An eye-opening journey to find out once and for all which is better: fresh or frozen food?

name: Edward Vs George: The Windsors at War
summary: The feud between Edward VIII and his younger brother George VI, featuring first-hand accounts from people close to the story, and new evidence from historians.

name: I am Married…But!
summary: I am Married…But! explores the realities of married life. I-ling (Alice Ko) has lived with her in-laws for three years and contemplates divorce every seven days. She wants to move out but is stuck because her husband, Zeng Xue-you (Jasper Liu), is a mummy's boy. Despite her frustrations, she always finds a hint of charm in him at crucial moments, trapping her in a cycle of wanting to leave but not being able to. Things take a turn when she meets a soulmate on a dating app, her body suddenly wants a baby, placing her in a tug-of-war between emotional infidelity and family life.

name: ACAB
summary:
A night of ferocious clashes in Val di Susa. A team from the Mobile Unit of Rome loses their chief, who is seriously injured. Mazinga, Marta and Salvatore's team, however, is not like the others, it's a team from Rome, which had to learn to contrast chaos and troubles with extreme methods as well as with the harmony of a tribe, almost like a family. A family that the new commander, Michele, part of the reformist police, will have to deal with. For such police, teams like that are the symbol of an old school that must be refounded. As if the chaos that hits the new squad at the moment of maximum internal fragility wasn't enough, there's also a new wave of people's discontent with institutions.

Among rising tensions, the team members are called to take sides and forced to question the deeper meaning of their work and their own membership of the Department.

name: Extraordinary World
summary: Extraordinary World will follow everyday people who are making an impact through animal advocacy, wildlife conservation, youth empowerment and food insecurity aid.

name: Женское шоу
summary: A show where popular comedians will show miniatures on the most different and unexpected topics. And star guests will help them! They will not only be the hosts, but will also take part in all the numbers.

name: Eight Hundred
summary: In the late 1990s, a mining town called Fengyang is shaken when the body of an unidentified woman is discovered. Police officer Chen Hongbing launches an investigation and soon notices that the glass fragments on the victim's neck closely resemble those from a bottle used to hold a banned drug. Not long after, while responding to a call, he discovers that someone in the town is consuming this illegal substance. Determined to uncover the truth and take down the drug trafficking ring, Chen Hongbing and his team dig deeper. But what he does not expect is that the person controlling everything behind the scenes is someone closest to him. Caught between duty and family, and torn between the law and human nature, this family and the entire town must face a test and a choice between good and evil.

name: Betting on Paradise
summary: Betting on Paradise the couple, with two young daughters in tow, will embark on their biggest and scariest adventure yet—moving sight unseen to the coastal town of Jacó and buying a crumbling piece of prime real estate with the dream of creating a luxury boutique hotel. With the financial backing of friends and investors on the line, Luke will employ his construction background and years working in trades and Steph will tap into her high-end hospitality experience to overcome massive structural issues, frustrating delays and shocking budget increases to bring Hotel Amavi to life in time for peak tourist season.

name: Christmas With The Australian Women's Weekly
summary: It is officially the holiday season, and Christmas With The Australian Women's Weekly is the perfect inspiration for flawless festivities.

name: Argentina '78
summary: In a time where dictatorships were commonplace, Argentina hosted the most significant sport event on the planet. As thousands of people were abducted and taken to concentration camps, the military saw the World Cup as an opportunity to legitimize their power. Meanwhile, millions of Argentine fans followed the matches, seeking a glimmer of light between the dark. Across four episodes, this documentary weaves together soccer, horror, and political intrigue to tell a story that is both unique and unforgettable.

name: Nyaight of the Living Cat
summary: Run! In 20XX, the world is dominated by cats. A virus that turns anyone who touches a cat into a cat has spread into a worldwide nyandemic. Anytime cats rub against a human, they turn the person into a cat. Can humanity fight their urge to pet cats to survive in a cat-ridden world?

name: Oppdrag M/S Bjørvika
summary: Join M/S Bjørvika on a wild tour along the Norwegian coast! Six participants join artist Vidar Villa at sea. The six live, work and party together, and compete to win the Mission M/S Bjørvika.

name: Kan vi hjelpe til?
summary: An inspiring and entertaining renovation show where the two self-taught craftsmen Stine Skoli and Mads Clemmetsen travel to the hardware store and help realize people's dream projects.

name: Frie tøyler
summary:
In Frie Tøyler, viewers get to go inside the Norwegian galloping community, a fascinating world where strong personalities, lots of money, reputation and big dreams collide. The series is not only about fast horses and expensive competitions, but also provides a unique insight into the people who live and breathe the sport.

This is a docu-reality that explores both the professional and personal lives of jockeys, trainers, horse owners, and the support system around the galloping sport. Through the season's six episodes, the audience gets up close and personal with their everyday lives, challenges, ups, downs, and the unique atmosphere that is created in their community.

name: Kjartan rydder opp – hjemme
summary: Master chef Kjartan Skjelde cleans up the kitchens of ten Norwegian celebrities who all need help finding the joy of food, inspiration and confidence to cook and invite friends home.

name: Den rette for Gunilla
summary: Gunilla Persson travels to Norway to test Norwegian men. She throws herself into the dating world – but will the confident Norwegian handle her glamorous style and is there the right one for Gunilla here?

name: Familien Nerdrum
summary: Artist Odd Nerdrum and his family open the doors to their private realm in this documentary series. Viewers get a rare opportunity to get up close to the family and one of Norway's most fascinating and controversial painters.

name: Golden Kamuy: Hokkaido Shisei Shujin Soudatsuhen
summary: Set immediately after movie "Golden Kamuy," the hunt for the escaped prisoners with the tattoos that collectively reveal the location of hidden gold is in full swing. Retired war veteran Sugimoto Saichi and Ainu native Asirpa are in the hunt to find the gold before others do so and their journey to find the gold nuggets enters a new phase.

name: Taste
summary: Taste follows the employees at a legacy food magazine in the Bay Area. When the publication is bought by a Silicon Valley tech mogul, its traditionalist editor is suddenly forced to work with a young, buzzy TikTok chef.

name: Duo
summary: In Duo, when a soft-spoken, blue-collar worker and a magnetic performer looking for her next break unexpectedly cross paths, their fateful meeting leads to a partnership that changes them both forever. The project is described as a family drama centered around a new two-person band and the disruption their rapidly rising career has on both their lives and the lives of those closest to them.

name: Merteuil
summary: After being brutally betrayed, Isabelle turns her hunger for vengeance into seduction – climbing her way amongst Paris' glittering elite.

name: Zenshuu
summary: After graduating from high school, Natsuko Hirose starts her career as an animator. Her talent quickly flourishes, and she makes her debut as a director in no time. Her first anime becomes a massive hit, sparking a social phenomenon and earning her recognition as an up-and-coming genius director. Her next project is set to be a romantic comedy movie themed around first love! However, having never been in love herself, Natsuko struggles to understand the concept of first love, and as a result, she's unable to create the storyboard, causing the movie production to come to a standstill. One day, she passes out while working on her storyboard and wakes up in the world of her favorite childhood anime movie "A Tale of Perishing".

name: 4 et demi...
summary: The series is based on the central couple of Louis and Isabelle and the people around them: the best friend of Louis, Francois Dion, Isabelle does not like, the best friend Isabelle, Maryse Lemieux, that Louis does not love their neighbors, Julien Champagne and his daughter Gabrielle; colleagues in the veterinary clinic where Dufour Louis works: Pamela Lalonde, Marjolaine Tremblay, not to mention Dr. Pascal Constantin ...

name: Objects of Affection
summary: A season of plays by Alan Bennett

name: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger
summary: After the Heath Oslo incident exposed the U.S.-Japanese anti-terror organization CIRS, a new agency emerges to train elite operatives: SORD. Mihama Academy, once abandoned, is now part of a series of SORD training grounds for misfit girls to hone their deadly skills. Armed with live ammunition, they face perilous missions, sacrificing their safety for the country's future.

name: Selling Superman
summary: A 40-year secret comic book collection and the chance to write his own ending. Darren's father collected comic books in a genius yet obsessive way that destroyed the family. Now Darren holds the keys to 300,000 comics, a Superman #1, and a chance to change his family's legacy by selling one of the most expensive comics of all time.

previousepisode.name: Will the Real Superman Please Stand Up

name: You Want Some?
summary: Seonwoo, a man with an irresistible charm that leaves every girl bewitched and eager to confess, meets Jaeheon, who unexpectedly finds himself falling helplessly for him. Their story begins with a playful rivalry sparked by a daring bet—who will confess their feelings to the other person first.

name: Murder of a Moderate Man
summary: Drama serial by John Howlett set five years after the murder of a moderate Middle Eastern politician.

name: WWE LFG
summary: WWE LFG (Legends & Future Greats) will offer viewers an inside look at the rigorous training process, featuring iconic WWE Legends such as Paul "Triple H" Levesque and Shawn Michaels and weekly regular coaches Undertaker, Booker T, Mickie James and Bubba Ray Dudley as they mentor a new generation in weekly matches on their quest to become the next WWE Superstars.

name: WWE's Greatest Moments
summary: WWE's Greatest Moments will feature legendary play-by-play announcer Michael Cole hosting half-hour episodes with various WWE Superstars & Legends, including "Stone Cold" Steve Austin, Hulk Hogan, Kevin Owens and others, to share vivid recollections and perspectives on the most remarkable moments in wrestling history.

name: Wild Rose
summary: The fallen heiress, Cheng Youran, changes her face and conceals her identity to avenge her mother's murder and reclaim her family property. Adopting the identity of her close friend, Su Xinyue, she pretends to have an engagement with Xu Shian, the heir of Xingyun Group and the son of her mother's killer. As she gathers evidence, Xu Shian gradually figures out her true identity. But, instead of exposing her, he silently protects her and secretly helps Cheng Youran with her revenge plan. As Cheng Youran peels back the layers of truth, she discovers that the true mastermind behind the tragedy was someone else.

name: Love on the Edge of Divorce
summary: Three years later, Sheng Mian and Fu Yancheng, who hadn't met each other, wanted to end their arranged and loveless marriage. They had several appointments, but always failed to meet. Accidentally, they had a one-night stand. When they met again, they misunderstood each other even more due to wrong emotional expressions. Fu Yancheng really regretted it when he got to know Sheng Mian was Penny and she was pregnant. He did everything he could to get her back. They finally straightened everything out, fell in love, and decided to spend the rest of their lives together.

name: No Pain No Gain
summary: After being fired from a major corporation, office worker Pei Qian receives an unexpected offer from a mysterious tycoon to start a company with a single goal: Losing money. He assembles a team of unreliable misfits and launches the "Pei Qian Plan", deliberately raising salaries, extending holidays, offering generous benefits, and investing in one absurd project after another in hopes of failure. Instead, every attempt backfires into success, turning losses into profits again and again. Pei Qian becomes a celebrated boss among his employees and a recognized business prodigy in the industry, while he himself suffers from getting rich against his will. With no escape, he continues searching for new opportunities to turn the tide and finally…

name: Rebirth
summary: At the Battle of Ice Lake, Zhuge Yue and Chu Qiao fall into the frozen lake. Chu Qiao is rescued by Yan Xun and learns that Zhuge Yue is dead. She seizes the opportunity to assassinate Yan Xun, avenging Zhuge Yue. In Bian Tang, Chu Qiao receives help time and again from a mysterious man. She feels a strange sense of familiarity, and can't help but suspect that Zhuge Yue may still be alive. Meanwhile, Yan Xun grows even more ruthless, igniting war across four kingdoms. In the end, can Chu Qiao bring peace to the realm and make Yan Xun see the error of his ways? Can she stand side by side with Zhuge Yue once more, restoring a homeland for the people?

name: Shine
summary: A tale of love and ideals unfolds in an era resistant to diversity set against the backdrop of the political turmoil of 1969-1971. Trin, a principled economist, collides with Thanwa, a free-spirited hippie. When they encounter Moira, an extravagant widow who lives far beyond the boundaries of freedom, their lives take an unpredictable turn.

name: Top Form
summary: Akin, an actor since childhood, has been recognized as "The Sexiest Man of the Year" in the entertainment industry for five consecutive years. However, his first-place position has been usurped by young newcomer actor Jin. While Akin first sees him as a rival, Jin, on the other hand, admires Akin greatly and is in love with him.

name: Love of Silom
summary: Krit is a handsome young police officer from a family of Chinese descent. He is deeply filial. Outwardly, he complies with his father's wishes by enrolling in the Police Academy following in his father's footsteps as a senior officer in the National Police Bureau. However, Krit never truly wanted to become a police officer. His family strongly opposes same-sex relationships, his father threatening harm if he were to date a man. As a result, Krit keeps his relationship with his boyfriend secret. Despite this, their love remains strong. Krit works hard to support his boyfriend's dream of becoming an idol, but after he succeeds, he cruelly abandons Krit. Heartbroken, Krit becomes cold and disinterested in love. Wayu is a student burdened by severe family issues. Neglected by his parents, he cares for his younger sister who later runs off after having a baby and leaving the child with Wayu. Forced to take responsibility, Wayu starts working at a nightclub. One day, during an altercation with a client, Krit comes to his rescue, marking the beginning of their relationship. For the first time, Wayu feels warmth and admiration for Krit and he determinedly makes frequent trips to the police station. Krit, at first, views Wayu with indifference. Over time, however, he begins encouraging Wayu through his hardships, leading to deeper bonds and mutual comfort.

name: Monsters of the Deep: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea
summary: This two-part programme explores the world of deep-sea killers, revealing mysterious creatures using cutting-edge CGI.

name: The Sweets & Treats We Loved & Lost
summary: Step back in time and remember the tastes of your childhood, as we celebrate the iconic sweets and snacks we loved - and lost - across the decades. From Texan to Tooty Frooties, Fruit Salads to Flying Saucers, Parma Violets to Pacers, Horror Bags to Hedgehog Crisps... and treats that didn't stand the test of time, like Candy Cigarettes. Unwrapping the secret stories behind our favourite sweets and snacks, we also relive rituals - from the best way to tackle a Sherbet Fountain to the dangers of a black tongue after too many Black Jacks.

name: Jewels of the Mediterranean
summary: The Mediterranean is home to some of the most spectacular islands and coastlines. Across this series, narrated by Joanna Lumley, we meet locals and tourists, sample mouthwatering local cuisine and explore ancient traditions as we uncover the true Jewels of the Med.

name: Police Surgeon
summary: In the down-home medical series, Jack Albertson played an elderly country doctor in Dixon Mills, USA, who was training his young successor, Simon Locke. The first season was televised by some Canadian stations, despite not being aired across the entire CTV network. As Simon Locke transitioned from a rural physician to a major city police surgeon, the show's title was changed to Police Surgeon after the first season.

name: Казаки-разбойники
summary: One day, in a quiet Meshchersk near Moscow, events occur that dramatically change the lives of seven friends-classmates who have just graduated from school, as well as their older relatives. On a dark suburban highway, the guys hit a pedestrian with a car, who mysteriously disappears from the scene of the accident. The car belongs to a well-known person in the city - a successful businessman nicknamed the Cossack, and his nephew, the Cossack, drove it. The incident can get loud publicity and serious consequences: the Cossack has just concluded a lucrative deal with foreign investors, who will certainly refuse to cooperate if they find out that their new partner is involved in crime.

name: Private Banker
summary: A private banker, known for managing assets of high-net-worth clients, excels in protecting their wealth with extensive financial expertise and a wide network of connections

name: Devil's Ranch
summary: Devil's Ranch follows a group of ex-military personnel who operate a ranch on the Texas-Mexico border by day and conduct various missions across the globe by night.

name: Speed and Love
summary: The series revolves around the siblings Jiang Mu, the sheltered and pampered younger sister, and Jin Zhao, the extremely gifted older brother. When Mu is nine years old, their parents get a divorce and her father and Zhao move to Thailand. As such, Mu and Zhao's lives become two paths that never cross. After learning that her brother is adopted, Mu flies to Thailand alone. When they meet again, the once elegant boy has transformed into a rugged young man hardened by the streets. Zhao is now into boxing and racing, living a life full of wild thrills and danger that is completely unfamiliar to Mu. Undaunted, Mu works to assimilate into the life of Zhao and her father's family. Aligning with her talents, her studies and life in Thailand are just as splendid, and her enthusiasm and empathy brightens Zhao's life. As Zhao's co-pilot, she is his perfect navigator. Seeing that Zhao is stuck in a quagmire, she decides to pull him out and take him home. When an accident separates the two again, Mu takes on the responsibility of taking care of the family while fulfilling their shared ambition and aerospace dream. Many years later, Mu returns to China after graduation. Mu and Zhao reunite again in Nanjing, expressing their affection to each other in their own ways. From then on, like the glorious sun in the day and the bright moon in the night, their love shine and glow for an eternity, never to be separated again

name: Tattletales
summary: The game show features celebrities & their spouses playing for sections of the studio audience, trying to match answers to questions about their personal lives.

name: Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms
summary: Gorgeous from head to toe! The perfect figure! To Kawai Mona, winning hearts comes as naturally as breathing... but the arrival of Kuroiwa Medaka, a new transfer student who won't even give her a second look, turns her school life upside-down! She's lived her whole life being fawned over, so why is he any different? Mona tries everything she can think of to win Medaka over, even getting a bit extreme at times!

name: Scandalous Lives of the Georgian Kings
summary: The Georgian kings belong to one of the most dysfunctional royal dynasties in British history. Loved and loathed by the public in equal measure, their scandals, backstabbings, feuds and betrayals shaped an entire era of British history.

name: White Collar Gangsters
summary: Discover the stories of con men who fooled the system. Each have turned to crime. These people are exceptionally talented, but also have huge egos and have conned millions of victims by flirting with the limits of the law to create their empires. We discover the incredible stories of these next-generation criminals.

name: De Tatta's: De Serie
summary: In De Tatta's: The Series we follow the hilarious Van Kampen family in their daily adventures. Erik struggles with his Tatta identity as he desperately tries to get out of debt. Laura looks for a job to support the family, Daan clumsily pursues love and Jessica finds her footing at her first job. And Richard? He argues with everyone, but remains irresistible.

name: Uonderbois: Il Tesoro Segreto di Napoli
summary: Five inseparable friends, the Uonderbois, must say goodbye because La Vecchia, owner of the villas in which they live, is about to sell their homes in exchange for a statuette of Maradona. When the statuette is stolen by their idol, Tonino Uonderboi, the new Munaciello of Naples, their adventure begins in the city's underground, in search of a mysterious treasure.

name: Миллион вопросов
summary: A new show with the iconic TV presenter Dmitry Dibrov, in which he will return to the interview genre. The master's guests will be people of art, stars of show business, the Internet and sports, heroes of the infospace and trendsetters of the generation, legends of the era. Viewers will enjoy a unique graphic design: inserts between interview blocks with detailed infographics about the stages of the hero's life and creative path. And, of course, a million sharp and interesting questions from the host.

name: Winter Palace
summary: Based on true events, "Winter Palace" is centred around ambitious proprietor Andre Morel, who, in 1899, envisions a five-star luxury hotel that will remain open throughout winter. He convinces wealthy aristo Lord Fairfax to come on board, and the two find themselves battling demanding clientele, rebellious staff and a hostile climate to make their dream a reality.

name: Lady Love
summary: Lucyna Liss takes viewers to the temptations and dangers of the porn industry, as well as the crazy 80s in Germany and the 90s in Poland, which was just waking up to life.

name: Homicide Squad New Orleans
summary: To safeguard their streets, the New Orleans Police Department boasts a dedicated team of homicide detectives, many of whom are natives of the legendary city. "Homicide Squad New Orleans" chronicles the harrowing work of this committed group of men and women united against the odds to protect their city and home. In each episode, the team will be faced with a new case and tasked with putting together the evidence to catch the perpetrator, find answers for the victims loved ones, and keep their community safe.

name: Fugitive Hunters Mexico
summary: Every year, hundreds of wanted Americans flee to Mexico to evade justice, thinking once they've crossed the border, they're home free. What these fugitives don't know is that there's an elite Mexican police unit whose sole mission is to catch them. In this groundbreaking new series, viewers follow this undercover unit as they investigate, track, and capture American fugitives. With intel from the FBI, DEA, US Marshals and Mexican authorities, this taskforce locates and apprehends US fugitives hiding out in Mexico to hand them over to law enforcement in the US to face justice for their crimes.

name: Ландыши. Такая нежная любовь
summary: In the story, Katya Orlova and Lekha Danilin meet in a small town and get married on the same day. He is an ordinary guy, and she is the refined daughter of a billionaire, who grew up in London and lost her parents in a car accident. Their relationship is a struggle of opposites.

name: Hoarders: Where Are They Now?
summary: Five years after Hoarders first aired, A&E produced a series of follow-up episodes that detailed ex-hoarders' lives, leaving many fans wondering what happened to some of the show's most infamous figures.

name: OKITSURA: Fell in Love with an Okinawan Girl, but I Just Wish I Know What She's Saying
summary: When Teruaki Nakamura transfers to laid-back Okinawa, he falls for the lively Kyan-san—but her dialect is a complete mystery to him. With Higa-san translating, Teru's misunderstanding-filled island life takes off...and subtle hints suggest Higa-san might want his heart too. On this serene island, love flows as freely as the ocean breeze!

name: Ultimate Christmas Gift Guide with Josie Gibson
summary: Josie Gibson's got Christmas all wrapped up with the ultimate guide to gifting, packed full of savvy saves, tips and hacks, to make the countdown to Christmas as stress-free as possible.

name: Nepobaby
summary: Nepobaby is about the dream of a family, and what it does to a person when this family you dream of comes with enormous wealth and a way of life that is completely different from your own. How are you supposed to suddenly maneuver through this without losing yourself? In the middle of it all stands down-to-earth and naive Emma – in wedding preparations with her boyfriend Nico and single mother Mona.

previousepisode.name: Kjenner du meg virkelig så dårlig?

name: Donkmaster
summary: The network hits the street literally with DONKMASTER. In a motorsport subculture show like no other, Sage Thomas (a.k.a. The Donkmaster) is the king of the donk street race scene throughout the South, leaving everyone else in his dust. The show follows him and his crew before and more importantly during these all-out street races with mobile works of art.

name: Faces of Evil
summary:
Faces of Evil is a gripping true crime series in which we revisit the nefarious deeds of some of the world's most infamous killers from the UK and America. From relentless serial killers to remorseless child murderers, this series uncovers the evil behind their often unassuming faces.

Each episode combines first-hand accounts from detectives who worked on the cases, with expert analysis from a criminologist and a forensic psychologist. As we re-examine the evidence that led to the capture of these dangerous criminals, we're asking the question: could anything have been done differently?

previousepisode.name: Billy Dunlop - The Body Under The Bath Killer

name: Uten synlige tegn
summary: Never before have Norwegian hospitals received so many children and young people with unexplained symptoms. Where other doctors and health institutions have spent months investigating without results, Elin and Hans Petter take the time to look at the child's entire history and ask questions that have never been asked before.

name: Jesus Crown of Thorns
summary: An epic 8-part docudrama that tells the story of Jesus Christ like never before. This political thriller reveals Jesus's story with shifting allegiances and infighting where a revolutionary dared to challenge the status quo.

name: Swiped: The School That Banned Smartphones
summary: Emma and Matt Willis challenge a group of Year 8 pupils at the Stanway School in Colchester to give up their smartphones completely for three weeks.

name: Guy Martin: Arctic Warrior
summary: Guy Martin heads 200 miles above the Arctic Circle to embed with the Royal Marines. Does he have what it takes to operate in the harshest environments as a special operations commando?

name: Up & Adams
summary: Kay Adams and a rotating roster of current and former players discuss the biggest NFL storylines.

name: Branio sam Mladu Bosnu
summary: When Gavrilo Princip killed Franz Ferdinand, Austrian future king, the World War I began. What will Gavrilo Princip do? He has to choose, hard jail untill death, or hanging. There are so many things happening in Bosnia.

name: Trigger
summary: An action thriller drama that depicts what happens when guns of unknown origin are unleashed in South Korea, a gun-free country, and guns are given to angry people one by one.

name: À nous l'histoire
summary: In a Baroque library setting, five young actors retrace major historical events - from Joan of Arc to September 11, passing through the death of Louis XIV, the Battle of Marignan or the fall of the Berlin Wall... They discuss , question themselves and share their universe and their good humor with us.

name: Nevertheless: The Shapes of Love
summary: Kosaka Ren arrives in Japan to take up a special temporary lecturer position at an art university in Kamakura, Japan. He is a young and talented artist, who has a certain aura about him to make people want to get closer to him, but he also keeps a certain distance from everyone around him. Like butterflies that surround a flower, he is surrounded by other people. One day, he meets a certain woman and, because of her, his emotions begin to change. Even though he knows it will hurt ... nevertheless.

name: I'm Your Pet
summary: Kitami Makoto once led a life full of betrayal and had lost his ability to trust others. Similarly, Ashihara Ritu is bound by past wounds, struggling to live within his own despair. By chance, the two meet and begin a peculiar shared life together. Ritu's innocent and unpretentious approach to life starts to melt Makoto's closed-off heart, allowing him to feel trust and affection once more. However, the relationship between Makoto and Ritu is far from simple, as their pasts loom over them like insurmountable walls. Facing their weaknesses and despair, the two begin to grow together. How will Makoto reclaim his lost sense of self, and will his relationship with Ritu illuminate a new path for them both? Their future now begins to take shape, bit by bit.

name: Medisch Centrum West
summary: After thirty years, the most famous hospital in the Netherlands is reopening. In Medical Center West we follow the ups and downs of doctors and nurses in the emergency department (ED) and their mutual relationships in and around the hospital.

name: Fresh Off the Sea
summary: Discover a variety of seaside jobs and savor seasonal delicacies unique to the coast! Yum Jung-ah, Ahn Eun-jin, Park Jun-myun, and DEX's nationwide seaside tour filled with sweat and laughter begins.

name: I Love You Bit by Bit
Perfect Crown
summary: Welcome to 21st-century Korea, a constitutional monarchy where tradition and modernity intertwine in style, and glamour masks a rigid social hierarchy. Seong Huiju, a brilliant chaebol heiress and CEO, seems to have everything. Yet as a commoner by birth, she is always denied the respect she deserves. When her family begins relentlessly pushing her toward future marriage prospects, Huiju grows determined to take control of her own future after she crosses paths with Grand Prince lan at the Imperial Birthday Banquet. She has everything but status, whereas he has nothing but status. Together, they enter a contract marriage of the century. But can they break societal barriers and carve out their own destinies?

name: Konflikti
summary: A small, Finnish seaside town is preparing to celebrate midsummer's eve. An unknown enemy arrives and takes the entire area hostage.

name: An t-Eilean
summary: Set against the elemental landscape of the Outer Hebrides, An t-Eilean is a compelling crime story that follows a family caught up in a murder investigation very close to home. When their mother is found murdered in the family castle, four adult children return to the Scottish island of their birth as their father is questioned over her death.

name: Open Water
summary:
Marcus works in retail while trying to develop a career as a photographer. Effie is studying dance at university in Dublin. From the moment they meet, they feel an immediate, undeniable connection. But, as Marcus soon learns, Effie is in a relationship with Marcus' friend Samuel. It's a boundary that Marcus is unwilling to cross. A shared project, photographing and documenting Black creatives in London, draws them into each other's orbit, but can their burgeoning friendship resist the pull of desire?

They seem destined for each other, their crush evolving into a love that is ocean-deep. But love is never enough, and their path towards one another is treacherous. Will they sink or swim in open water?

name: Ceolta
summary: Ceolta takes viewers on a musical journey visiting venues in Dungiven, Moy, Bangor, Forkhill, Boho and Belfast and our presenters - singer and songwriter Eve Belle from County Donegal and Hothouse Flowers' guitarist Fiachna Ó Braonáin who hails from Dublin - also take to the stage for two special performances.

previousepisode.name: Hoe moeilijk is het om politiek met het gezin te combineren?

name: Outta Town Adventures
summary: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best adventures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and positive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town!

name: Takopi's Original Sin
summary: Happy alien Takopi, lands on Earth with one mission: to spread happiness! When he meets Shizuka, a lonely fourth grader, he vows to bring back her smile using his magical Happy Gadgets. But as he uncovers the pain in her life, Takopi learns that true happiness may require more than gadgets.

name: Rugged Rugby: Conquer or Die
summary: In the shadows of Korea's rugby world, seven teams engage in a fierce battle of strength, strategy, and teamwork — all vying to be crowned champion.

name: Mikaela Shiffrin: Passion & Purpose
summary: A five-part docuseries intimately uncovering the many layers of the most dominant ski racer on the planet. At just 26 years old, Mikaela Shiffrin has been rewriting the record books since she was 16. But the tragedies of the past 18 months have sent her and her family down a path she is unfamiliar with, and rediscovering her passion and purpose will be paramount heading through the biggest season of her carerrr.

name: Routeless
summary: Hitting the open road with BMX legend Heath Pinter and Filmmaker Ian Beaudoux for a journey full of BMX, motorcycles, shops, and racing.

name: Super Mâles
summary: Super Mâles follows a group of long-time friends, whose romantic and professional lives are turned upside down by the women in their lives. Cédric, Tom, Jérémie, and Tonio, struggle to find their place and find love in a society that questions patriarchy and gradually deprives them of their privileges.

name: Crown Lake Diaries
summary: Crown Lake Diaries follows Cleo McCall as she breaks down the latest gossip from Crown Lake Academy, telling stories that will expose scandals among the students and uncover fresh new secrets about the school along the way.

previousepisode.name: Who Is Crown Lake's Biggest Bully?

name: Bloomers
summary: An out of work actor is offered a partnership in his friend's florists shop.

name: Bull Week
summary: A story of a Midlands factory.

name: Elephant's Eggs in a Rhubarb Tree
summary: Children's comedy show featuring sketches, songs and limericks.

name: Bingo Blitz
summary: In the Bingo Blitz game show on Game Show Network, two contestants compete in a dynamic blend of trivia and bingo. The ultimate game of knowledge, strategy and luck, contestants answer trivia to earn bingo balls and points. In addition to numbered bingo balls, players also receive gold balls they can strategically place on their cards to increase their chances of making a bingo. Bingos earn the players bonus points, and special ‘power-ups' on the players' cards earn them extra points, bingo balls and prizes. After three rounds, the player with the highest score advances to the fast-action Blitz round, where making a bingo in 60 seconds or less awards them $10,000.

name: The Long Watch
summary: A major leak case around the turn of the century strikes at the heart of cross-strait dynamics, masking a sharp battle between foreign operatives and our own forces along the covert front. In the late 1990s, an unlikely mentor-apprentice duo at Minzhou's State Security Bureau, with starkly different temperaments, are thrown together by fate to serve the same mission and faith. They manage to thwart multiple schemes, but their lives remain tangled with their enemy across a twenty-year span. As the new era reshapes the balance of power in national security, the hidden war continues without pause. Again and again tested by human nature, the three see their bonds and destinies silently transformed by the choices they make through time.

name: Wo He Wo De Ying Xiong
Bloom Life
summary: It tells the story of three sisters who grew up in the old town of Kashgar. They face life's difficulties head-on, break through, and grow in the collision between tradition and modernity. They join hands to cross the storms of life, heal each other with love and warmth, and restart their lives.

name: The Narcotic Operation
summary: In 1995, after smuggler Lu Shaohua went bankrupt overnight, he discovered the huge profit potential of a new drug, methamphetamine, and became a drug manufacturer. At the same time, anti-drug police Lin Qiangfeng, after finishing his undercover mission, was transferred to the West Port City Narcotics Control Team to follow up on drug-related clues. Over the years, Lin Qiangfeng and his team were dedicated to the anti-drug campaign, while Lu Shaohua traveled both domestically and internationally, connected with various drug lords and became more and more ambitious. Ultimately, the anti-drug police represented by Lin Qiangfeng lived up to their mission and broke through Lu Shaohua's complicated drug-related conspiracy.

name: Archives: The Nanyang Mystery
summary: In the early years of the Republic of China era, a bizarre murder case known as "Water Ghost Longing for Home" occurs at sea in Nanyang. Zhang Haiyan and Zhang Haixia, two staff members from the Southern Archives dispatched by the Zhang family to investigate the mysterious events, are drawn into a deadly trap used to hunt down members of the Zhang family overseas. Haixia offers his life in a scheme to break the deadlock, sending Haiyan aboard the giant ship, the Nan'an, back to Xiamen, in hopes of giving him a chance to survive. However, this turbulent voyage seems to have only just begun. A powerful warlord, a naive and persistent young accountant, and a dearest friend he has not seen for ten years... Haiyan faces a series of unexpected events alone, and the moment he sets foot in Xiamen, the true destiny of the two young men begin to unfold...

name: Life is a Choice
summary: Gu Nian, who got married right after graduation, is exhausted by her marriage life. She unexpectedly gets a chance to a high-tech "immersive life" experience, which allows her to go back to the past and make new choices. Gu Nian is determined to change her attitude towards life this time and not be so "love-oriented." However, defying all expectations, she neglects to choose the character's gender and accidentally transmigrates into an unfamiliar man's body, and the young Gu Nian from seven years ago is standing right in front of her... She must now use this male shell to save her former self, and what awaits her is one perplexing "life choice question" after another.

name: Misaligned Lover
summary: Amid the ups and downs of marriage, Yan Lidong and Mu Chenxi find their fates intertwined. Misunderstandings and conflicts push them to the brink of divorce. However, when Yan Lidong is injured while saving Mu Chenxi, he unexpectedly loses his memory, causing his mind revert to that of a 19-year-old. As they navigate this unexpected turn, Mu Chenxi begins to realise the neglect and indifference she once showed. Through her time with her husband, whose heart and memories remain at 19, she gradually rediscovers the power of love and its sweetness.

name: Genius comes First
summary: Li Yanhao, a freshman, stands up for justice but is wrongly accused of being a "pervert" by the so-called victim, Li Jiatong, ruining his reputation on campus. Frustrated, he unexpectedly reunites with his childhood friend, Yu Lan, who is organizing a campus film festival and forming a team to shoot short films. Despite the team being full of beginners, this new project gives the downhearted Li Yanhao a fresh direction in life.

name: The Daily Life of a Middle-Aged Online Shopper in Another World
summary: Kenichi Hamada is just a regular, middle-aged man working as an illustrator in Japan. One day, he is transported to another world and wakes to find himself in the middle of a dangerous forest filled with ravenous monsters. He quickly discovers a massive online shopping site that can deliver him exactly what he needs. Join Kenichi on his search for relaxation in a new world!

name: The 6000 lb Diaries with Dr. Now
summary: The 6000 lb Diaries with Dr. Now follows ten morbidly obese individuals as they fight for a chance to live the life they have always wanted, both for themselves and for their loved ones. Reaching a combined weight of more than 6,000 pounds, and at an extreme breaking point, these individuals are turning to weight loss authority Dr. Now, and his team of specialists, to get life-changing bariatric surgery and acquire the tools they need to deal with emotional eating. Through intimate diary cams and confessionals, each episode highlights one person's comprehensive experience as they share intimate inner thoughts, emotional and physical struggles, and their ultimate journey to take back their lives.

name: Scam Goddess
summary: As a hit podcaster, comedian Laci Mosley knows her way around a scam. Now, she's taking her expertise on the road, uncovering small-town swindles and big-city cons across the US. From Ponzi schemes to religious scammers to fake royalty, Laci meets whistleblowers, victims, and even the scammers themselves—tracking down the culprits with her signature wit, leaving no stone—or scam—unturned.

name: Mohrey
summary: The brutal murder of a Kabaddi captain introduces us to Bosco the only living underworld gang lord in the city. The assassination attempt on the Chief Minister at a painting exhibition is unsuccessful thanks to his bulletproof vest, but his bodyguards are killed. Journalist Asmi witnesses the attack and breaks the news, gaining a lead to investigate.

name: Друзі
summary: "Friends" is an action-packed series about true male friendship, which is able to withstand any obstacles, which even war cannot break. According to the plot, three best friends Serhii, Yarik and Roma decide to surprise their friend, who serves in the Armed Forces, and visit him on the eve of his birthday. This frivolous, gambling idea becomes the beginning of an unpredictable journey from their native Odesa to Mykolaiv, and later through de-occupied villages and right into the epicenter of hostilities, because it turned out that their friend is not serving deep in the rear, but on the front line. Along the way, getting into adventures that become more dangerous with each kilometer, the heroes open deeper and deeper wounds of war and meet people who change them forever.

name: Моє кіно
summary: The main character, Sasha, is a master confectioner. Her ex-husband Danya is a talented screenwriter. They were a very beautiful couple, but they couldn't get over their loss together, and it destroyed their marriage. Danya is considered missing during a volunteer trip to the front. Sasha's cafe was destroyed by fragments of a Russian rocket. The girl has no money for repairs, so she decides to accept the offer of the producer of the TV channel, for which her ex-husband wrote the script, and finish the job. Moreover, according to the documents, Sasha is a legal co-author of Dana. The main character finds her husband's laptop and his notes about their life together, about which he dreamed of making a film. The girl begins to understand how different everything in their relationship was than it seemed to her. So her past pain turns into lines of the script of a new love story.

name: Тільки живи
summary: This is a story about a boy from whom the war took everything, but helped him find a new vocation, love and taught him to understand what is really valuable. According to the plot, the young director Vitka dreams of making a cool movie and getting on international festivals. But all plans are destroyed by a full-scale invasion, and now he has to reconsider his values. Shortly before the events, he meets the activist Oleksa, with whom he falls in love. The girl goes to the front, and in search of her, Vitka first starts volunteering, and later finds himself in the squad of the Ukrainian commander Chumak. Here he learns new skills: from holding a weapon to operating a drone, and becomes a participant in an important operation that puts the dots on the "i" in the long-standing confrontation between Ukrainian and Russian officers.

name: Звичайна людина
summary: Oleg always considered himself an ordinary person, without ambitions for heroism or fame. But when the war knocks on the door, his life turns upside down. Finding his daughter becomes his main goal. Having gone to the occupied territory, Oleg is faced with the lawlessness and cruelty of the invaders who commit atrocities. During the entire journey, the main character has to do the impossible: to save not only himself, but also the people around him.

name: Прикордонники
summary:
The series' plot takes place in September 2021, six months before the full-scale war with Russia. Young boys and girls from different parts of Ukraine, each for their reasons, enter the National Academy of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine. Some continue a family tradition, others join for the company of a school friend, and some make this decision after completing their military service. The cadets' mentor, ATO hero Ivan Krynytskyi, uses his methodology to turn newcomers into real combat officers.
"Border Guards" is the first national TV series about Ukrainian cadets created with the support of the National Academy of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine.

name: Евакуація
summary:
Evacuation is a story about a computer science teacher from Poland, Marius, who sets out to search for and rescue his 12-year-old daughter, Maria, from Mariupol, which is occupied by the russian army.
The hero meets incredible people who help him look for his daughter, and goes through a very difficult and dangerous path: more than once he finds himself on the verge of life and death, makes his way through the front line under fire, gets captured. The Ukrainian military reality changes the man: from a modest and indecisive teacher, he turns into a true hero of his time.

name: Під одним дахом
summary: The four-episode drama follows the events that begin on December 31, 2021. The main character, Svyatoslav, makes a long-awaited proposal to Marina, but the joyful moment is interrupted by a call from his ex-wife asking her to come help her son. In the end, all troubles are resolved and the heroes meet the new year 2022 with the hope that it will be peaceful. Some of them believe in a full-scale invasion, some consider all talk of a great war to be hype, but in general, everyone lives their everyday life and wants to believe in the best, until they wake up to the explosions on February 24. Fleeing from rocket attacks, Sviatoslav, like many from Kyiv in the first days of the full-scale invasion, goes outside the city to his mother's house, where he gathers his pregnant bride, son, ex-wife and mother-in-law under one roof. The relationship between the women becomes more and more tense, and Svyat cannot make a final choice between the past and the future. In a few days, the town is under occupation, the Russians start shooting civilians. To save themselves, the heroes must find a common language and use their only chance for evacuation.

name: Одна родина. Весілля
summary: The series takes place after 2014 in a de-occupied mining town that is gradually returning to peaceful life. The main characters are two families that have long been separated by quarrels and endless arguments. The misunderstanding between them does not subside even after the news of their children's engagement. To make matters worse, former friends and now sworn enemies Pavel Dotsenko and Grisha Kulikov become the main contenders for the mayor's office. The competition for the favor of the townspeople constantly leads to complicated, confusing, and sometimes funny situations. Will the enemies be able to unite on the verge of a full-scale invasion by Russia, and will they be able to become one family for the sake of the future?

name: Шлях
summary: The main character, Oleksii, is an employee of a volunteer organization, a talented negotiator, and an analyst. Even before the full-scale invasion, he helped families divided by the front line, facilitated the return of prisoners, and searched for the missing. To achieve his goals, Oleksii never shied away from using any connections, as his ultimate mission was to help. However, in 2022, as he personally confronts the atrocities of the Russian occupying forces and endures personal losses, he embarks on a challenging journey of transformation. His attitude toward the war, worldview, and principles undergo profound changes, ultimately leading to the collapse of his ideals.

name: Окуповані
summary: The series takes place during the full-scale Russian invasion. Roman, the main character of the series, helps his ex-wife Yulia and their son leave the city for the village where Yulia's parents live. The village seems to be a safer place, but within hours it is under occupation. The Russian invaders quickly established their order: looting shops, searching homes, and severely punishing anyone who resisted. Frightened and confused, the locals are trapped, but they do not lose hope for liberation. Realizing that help will be a long time coming, Roman decides to take decisive action and joins the guerrilla movement.

name: Вільні
summary: For more than eight years, Ukrainians have been fighting for their state and independence, believing in justice and victory. They are united by the desire for freedom, the will to defend it, and the power received from the heroes' native land. People on the home front also take part in the great struggle against evil.

name: Hunting History with Steven Rinella
summary:
Hunting History with Steven Rinella dives into history's greatest and most perplexing wilderness mysteries. With his deep knowledge of the wild, survival expertise, and unyielding curiosity and grit, Steve is uniquely positioned to look at these mysteries through a totally new lens, examining how people's interactions with their environment may rewrite the narrative on some of our most iconic legends.

By teaming up with wilderness experts, historians, archeologists, and enthusiasts, Steve will uncover stories of lost ships, vanished pioneers, ancient civilizations, unexplained phenomena, and more. With decades of experience honing an unparalleled mastery of wilderness skills, Steve takes the viewer on a journey to some of the most unforgiving landscapes in the country – from the snowbound peaks of the Sierra Nevada to the sun-scorched deserts of New Mexico, the remote wilds of Alaska, and the perilous waters of the Great Lakes. Ultimately, Steve connects history, nature, and human ingenuity in a thrilling quest to better understand our most enduring mysteries, our landscapes, and our relationship to wild places.

name: SNL50: Beyond Saturday Night
summary: SNL50: Beyond Saturday Night spotlights different elements of the show's history and legacy, exploring the intricacies of the legendary sketch comedy series.

name: Шпиталь
summary: The series takes place in a beautiful town on the border with Poland, where a field hospital has been set up during Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine. The main characters are doctors, volunteers, and highly qualified specialists from different countries: Ukraine, Israel, Poland, and America. They have given up their quiet lives to help and save the lives of those affected by the hostilities, both civilians and defenders who are heroically defending our country. Each of them has their own story, often based on real events. Amidst the loud sounds of war, the hospital becomes a place where new lives are born, where even love can emerge in painful circumstances.

name: Діти бомбосховищ
summary: The series tells about Ukrainian children and their parents who experienced the terrible realities of war. Every child faced with the horrors of war needs protection and help in the future. These are real stories about how strangers became close, about children's games, songs in the dark, bedtime stories, life underground, and about simple children's dreams. The world will never be the same again, and the worst thing that can happen in life now is to be born a Russian, especially if you are an adequate person.

name: Sen Ağlama İstanbul
summary: Set in Istanbul, this series revolves around an impossible love. Şehrazat, a resilient and hopeful young woman studying in medical school, dreams of a bright future with her beloved Ferhat. However, their lives are turned upside down when Ferhat is wrongfully sentenced to death. In a desperate attempt to save him from the gallows, Şehrazat turns to Büyükbey, a man known for his dark influence. But there is a catch that she's unaware of: no favor from Büyükbey comes without a price. As the unhappy marriage of Büyükbey's daughter, Şirin, and his nephew, Kubat, intertwines with his plans to maintain his empire, everyone's lives will be irrevocably changed, and nothing will ever be the same again.

name: Touch Me Like You Lied
summary:
It is adapted from the novel of the same name by Zaiyanwai. (Alternative title: "Half-ripe") . 

The story follows female producer-director Sang Ru, who finds herself trapped in a relationship that gives her quite a headache. During the push-and-pull romantic "game" between her and Zhou Tingzhao, she unexpectedly travels back ten years to her university days. Now with the soul of a 30-year-old, Sang Ru begins a series of "revenge" acts against the college-age Zhou Tingzhao, gradually discovering the true nature hidden beneath his outward shell. After experiencing one butterfly effect after another, the two finally gain the courage to face life head-on, healing and redeeming each other along the way.

name: ¿Yo fui una mujer florero?
summary: This insightful docuseries explores the objectification of women's bodies and beauty on Spanish television to boost viewership.

previousepisode.name: The Rime of the Ancient Mariner

name: Newtopia
summary: Set in an air defense unit in a high-rise building in Seoul, the drama depicts the process of a soldier, Jae-yoon, and his girlfriend, Yeong-joo, who have just been notified of a breakup, running toward each other while fighting a horde of zombies.

name: Śleboda
summary: Anka Serafin, a young anthropologist from Krakow, who escapes to the mountains in search of herself and accidentally discovers a corpse. Anka quickly becomes entangled in solving a murder mystery, and her fate is inextricably intertwined with Sebastian, a journalist looking for sensations, and Jędrek, a local policeman with whom she was close as a teenager.

name: Invisible
summary: Capi, a 12-year-old boy with a normal life, suffers from a terrible accident that causes him severe post-traumatic stress. No one seems to have more information: neither the school, his friends, nor his family can explain what has happened. However, the psychologist who treats him is willing to dive into his history and discover the reasons that have led him to this situation. Little by little, Capi begins to trust him and tells him that he has the power of invisibility, and that the terrible nightmares that lurk him every night have to do with the monsters and the dragon that haunt him. But in their history, they are not all threats. There is someone who does want to help you: a mysterious teacher, a newcomer to the institute, who will try by all means to make the invisible visible.

previousepisode.name: La chica del dragón en la espalda

name: The Assembly
summary:
The Assembly will see celebrities being questioned by a remarkable group of inquisitive interviewers who are autistic, neurodivergent and/or learning disabled. 

Each episode of The Assembly sees a different celebrity forced to cast aside everything they were ever taught by their media trainers as they face their most honest, funny, chaotic – and heartwarming – interview yet.

name: The Flip Off
summary: The Flip Off is a throwdown competition to see which ex can find, buy, renovate and flip a house for the biggest financial gain, earning the chance at ultimate bragging rights and a first-class vacation paid for by the loser.

name: Ruan Xiaofeng's Royal Love Quest
summary: A modern-day office worker is unexpectedly transported into the body of a noble princess, only to find herself deeply unwelcome. Even her newlywed husband, Prince Ling, gives her the cold shoulder. After enduring numerous pranks and humiliations, she makes a shocking discovery—the villain… is actually her? What's worse, she's even suspected of being involved in the mysterious death of Prince Ling's mother. Determined to turn her fate around, she introduces the people to stand-up comedy and brings scripted murder mysteries into the world of investigations. With endless tricks up her sleeve, she slowly catches the attention of the cold-faced prince. As they join hands, they uncover the truth behind the tragic fall of his mother…

name: Saviour
summary:
Saviour introduces us to a well-brought up medical student, Ben, who goes to a fancy-dress party, dressed in a police uniform. Ben only has eyes for Xenia, and when he sees her being attacked by a man on his way home, he has no choice but to intervene, urged on by a bystander innocently assuming he was a real police officer. When things go awry, he makes a desperate call to his dad, who tells Ben exactly what to do next.

Running parallel with Ben's story, we're introduced to Indy, a criminal barrister. Admired by all who work alongside her, Indy is going places as all her hard work, evening classes and dedication to her profession is beginning to pay off. When she meets a terrified Ben in a police cell, facing a charge of murder, she will have to navigate a world of police corruption, fervent press interest and a defendant who is keeping secrets from her.

Throughout the drama we are left asking the question – how far are you prepared to go to protect the ones you love?

name: LIAM
summary:
An android with the appearance of a teenager named Liam, helped by a group of young people, must escape the laboratory where he was secretly designed if he wants to avoid being reset. What he does not know is that a powerful weapon is hidden deep inside him.

Beneath his appearance of a 16-year-old teenager, Liam is in fact an android secretly designed in the World Artificial Intelligence Laboratory. His existence must be revealed at the Belmont science fair, which will bring together young geniuses from all over the world. However, Liam must escape the laboratory, and quickly, because one of his creators, Dr. Wood, wants to reset him since he knows that the android has developed emotions. What Liam does not know is that a powerful weapon is hidden deep inside him. A few kilometers away, far from suspecting the terrible threat that is rumbling, Rafaële, 17, is preparing to welcome the most promising scientists to her father's inn. While she is participating in the inauguration of the science fair, she comes face to face with Liam. A strange connection unites them on the spot. Upset by the young android's dismay, she agrees to help him escape, then to hide him at her home. Lonely and hypersensitive, Rafaële is not convinced that she is the ideal candidate to save humanity. So she decides to turn to her cousin Alexis and the young people she is hosting: Osny, Anne and Rym. Together, they will have to protect Liam, thwart Dr. Wood's plans and lead the investigation to discover the secret hidden in Belmont Forest. What if everything was connected?

name: Kobe: The Making of a Legend
summary: Kobe: The Making of a Legend traces the story of Kobe Bryant from his childhood in Italy to his athletic superstardom and provides an intimate look at his post-NBA aspirations as a storyteller and as a father. Featuring personal interviews with Kobe's former coaches, teammates and family friends, this illuminating series reveals the conflicts and the complications behind the man with the Black Mamba mentality.

name: Mandate
summary: Nong is a village doctor deeply respected by his community. Despite constant pressure from political parties, he refuses to enter politics, determined to protect his patients and his principles. Vee, the ambitious and educated son of a party leader, believes wholeheartedly in Nong's integrity and talent. Desperate to recruit him, and to prove his own worth, Vee is willing to cross every line, setting off a covert game where politics and desire collide. As an election battle intensifies and buried secrets surface, their bond grows increasingly complicated by power, betrayal, and longing.

name: Reset
summary: On the night of his greatest success, famous actor Armin dies after being betrayed by his lover. However, death is not the end. Going back in time and meeting mysterious fan TD, the path to superstardom begins again.

name: The Renovation
summary: Phee, an aspirant writer, insists to stay at the resort while its under renovation, an unexpected love blossoms between him and Arthit. What will happen when Arthit discovers their story was made into a novel? Will it lead to their romance gradually developing?

name: El Ángel de Aurora
summary: Aurora Campero, president of Corporativo Campero, faces betrayal from her sister Jezabel, who manipulates a construction worker to assault her. Aurora becomes pregnant, and her fiancé, Antonio, abandons her upon discovering the truth. Don Miguel, her father, takes the baby away and gives him to a humble family. Twenty-nine years later, Gabriel, now named Ángel, falls in love with Helena, Antonio's daughter, while Aurora continues to search for her son. The return of Antonio and the schemes of Jezabel and Demián complicate their lives, but the power of love and forgiveness prevails.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2: Eres el amor de mi vida y te amo

name: Oh My Ghost Clients
summary: Mu-jin is a labor attorney who gets paid for covering up the corruption of problematic companies while visiting labor sites with high industrial accident risks. One day, during an inspection of a factory, he faces a near-death crisis when steel materials collapse. At that moment, a Bodhisattva with a burning labor law book in hand appears before Mu-jin and forces him to sign a labor contract. Then, Mu-jin gains the ability to see ghosts, and to save his own life he also must solve various labor problems brought by the ghosts and resolve their grudges.

name: Jailbreak
summary: 10 contestants battle to escape from a specially built prison in Hertfordshire, England. The first to break out wins £100,000 from a £250,000 prize fund, but if they work together on the escape they each get a share of the total amount.

name: Study Group
summary: It follows the life of student Yoon Ga Min, who wants to be good at studying but is only good at fighting, as he forms a study group at the worst school on earth and tells a fierce story about college entrance exams. Yoon Ga Min, who looks like a model student but is a student of Yusung Technical High School, which is one of the worst schools to study at. Although he studies extremely hard, his grades don't rise in the slightest. Despite all that, Yoon Ga Min sits diligently at his desk with the goal of going to college. However, when his study group friends get bullied, Yoon Ga Min takes off his glasses and school uniform jacket to put his fighting skills to use. Lee Han Kyeong, Yoon Ga Min's teacher, dreams of seeing the school change for the better. Lee Han Kyeong tutored Yoon Ga Min during her university days and reunites with him when she is appointed as a temporary teacher, holding a secret.

name: Live or Love?
summary: Rivals Fang Li and An Hang accidentally get trapped in a virtual world, becoming a married couple. With opposing system missions, they must defeat each other to return to reality. As they battle it out, they start to fall for each other. Can they rewrite the system's rules and find a way out?

name: Culinary Vendetta
summary: To marry into the Grand General's Mansion, Princess Mingzhu schemed against Su Qianqian's family, leading to their downfall. Determined to fight back, Su Qianqian entered the mansion alongside Mingzhu, where the two engaged in a fierce battle of wits. With the support of the young general Chu Junyao, Su Qianqian successfully avenged her family and won everyone's admiration with her extraordinary culinary skills.

name: Mobius
summary: The series follows a brilliant and fearless "super detective" at the Hua'ao City Police Department, famed for solving every case that comes his way. But when a string of seemingly flawless murders occurs, his limits are pushed to the brink. The killer moves like a ghost, leaving no trace behind, as though they never existed. Amidst the shifting tides and hidden dangers of Hua'ao City, every shadow may conceal a deadly threat

name: Ціна втечі
summary: The plot is based on the story of an orphan, Marta, who dreams of finding happiness, comfort, family and, most importantly, love

name: Стиль
summary: A show in which stylist Alina German and comedian Sasha Vash invite stars to discuss their everyday looks, analyze mistakes and offer new options.

name: Onopgelost
summary: A headstrong female professor recruits a group of students to solve cold cases, recklessly pitting them against each other in the process.

previousepisode.name: Paradies oder Hölle? Die Teams kämpfen mit den Strapazen!

name: Good Luck Guys
summary: Who has the best survival strategies? Who does the desert bring to its knees? And for whom giving up is not an option? In the Thai jungle, twelve reality stars have to demonstrate their survival instincts in teams of two and exchange familiar comfort for new skills: Melissa Heitmann and Yasin Mohamed, Michaela Barresi and Kevin Schäfer, Michelle Daniaux and Dominik Brcic, Aurelia Lamprecht and Micha Student, Zoe Saip and Juliano Fernández as well as Jade Britani and Paco Herb. Which adventurous duo will be able to make their way and fly home with 20,000 euros in prizes? Joyn will bring the successful reality format "Good Luck Guys" from France to Germany for the first time, exclusively and free on Joyn starting November 9, 2023.
