name: Made in Mumbles
summary: Follow the lives of the locals in the seaside village of Mumbles, and find out what summer 2024 had in store.

name: Humoretaten
summary: Eight comedians come together to make you laugh, with skits about current events and life itself.

name: Monsen og nasjonalparkene
summary: Lars Monsen is on the road again! Now he's hunting for spectacular nature experiences and useful knowledge about the unique nature we have chosen to protect.

name: Drømmen om Venezia
summary: Captain Querini and his surviving crew drift ashore on Røst in 1432. Now 100 Røst residents want to take their story back to Italy – as an opera!

name: Нерождённая
summary: Alice senses the fine line between the worlds of the dead and the living and has been able to see ghosts since birth. She uses her gift to help a local investigator and is also eager to understand the circumstances of her mother's death.

name: Навигатор
summary: A nightmare comes true for Igor Berestov, the protagonist of "Navigator." His new life begins on a suburban highway. It was there that he came to his senses and realized the past had been erased from his memory. Almost simultaneously, Berestov became the prime suspect in the case of the Jeweler, a serial killer with a distinctive signature who murders young girls and places pearls in their mouths. In the woods near the highway, Berestov stumbled upon the body of one of the victims. And when he touched the girl, he "saw" the whole crime scene...

name: My Page in the 90s
summary: A laugh-a-minute romantic comedy where a 2025 feelings coach gets zapped into a cheesy vintage novel and meets her match, a 1999 CEO who's sweet on the outside but shrewd within. In the ultimate battle of romantic tactics, who will out-scheme whom? To get home, influencer Lin Huan'er launches an operation to win over CEO Gao Haiming, only for her clever plans to hilariously backfire. Just as her ticket home appears, she realizes her heart has already checked in for good. Can this cross-storybook couple write their own happy ending?

name: Pursuit of Jade
summary: This drama follows Fan Changyu, a butcher's daughter, and Xie Zheng, a fallen noble seeking revenge. Their fake marriage turns into true love, but war tears them apart. Determined, Fan Changyu wields her butcher's knife on the battlefield, searching for justice and her husband. Meanwhile, Xie Zheng reclaims his title, fighting to protect his country and love. Reunited in battle, they stand together, defying fate, uncovering the truth, and returning home without forgetting their vows.

name: Aquarion: Myth of Emotions
summary: The Aquarion, a giant mechanized fighting suit, is humanity's best weapon against interstellar threats. Human pilots trained and worked together to defeat Shadow Angels, invading Abductors, and kinetic energy monsters over thousands of years. Once again, humanity must turn to the Aquarion. With the fate of the Earth hanging in the balance, will the suit be enough to save mankind?

previousepisode.name: Let Us Share a Myth about Love

name: DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast
summary: DC and DC Studios are teaming up with Max to launch DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast, a new unscripted video podcast series created as a one-stop destination for all things DC and DC Studios.

name: Drill
summary: They break you down and build you up. Strip you of your individuality. Roast you, train you, drill you. Everyone's got a boot camp story…this is Drill, a sketch comedy series that recreates and parodies those most iconic moments and stories with drill instructors and drill sergeants.

name: Čornobiļa 2022. Iebrukums
summary: Latvian-Ukrainian co-production series based on the events discussed in the documentary "Chernobyl 2022" – three young friends go on an extreme trip to the closed zone of Chernobyl, shortly before the Russian invasion. The main character Santa acts at the centre of the series. She goes to the Chernobyl zone for a video blog and meeting here recently on Tinder met love.

name: Позивний "Тамада"
summary: The main character of the series, Artem Didov, is an almost forty-year-old presenter of wedding celebrations, a balladrasnik and the soul of the company. He lives a cheerful, carefree life, punctuated by odd jobs. Before the war, he loses everything - his bride leaves him, and later he becomes unemployed. On the eve of the invasion, Artem gets drunk and wakes up in the morning from explosions and a terrible hangover. Confused and devastated, Artem realizes that the war suddenly becomes a new reference point for him - a moment from which he can start building himself anew. Already in the training part, he is given the call sign "Tomboy", at first as a mockery, but later this call sign in the speech of his fellow students becomes more and more true respect. "Toaster" is not at all one of those who was born to be a hero, but forced to become one, although he treats it with a smile and humor.

name: Рубан
summary: The detective series ‘Ruban' tells about the work of a criminal psychologist who effectively and professionally solves criminal cases of high complexity with the help of his secret weapon - the subtleties of psychology.

name: Потяг
summary: A day before the start of a full-scale invasion, a young conductor receives a marriage proposal from the train master, but the beauty sees her future in a completely different way. But the war destroys all her plans. Polina's train becomes an evacuation train: instructions and timetables are in disarray, three times as many frightened and nervous passengers are crammed into the cars, there is a lack of water, food and medicine, a ruthless enemy is shooting from everywhere, and even the driver does not know the end point of the route. In addition, the scoundrel thief tries not only to make a small profit from human misery, but also to steal museum valuables that are being evacuated on the same flight.

name: Поклик кохання
summary: The first love of classmates Anna and Andriy is overshadowed by Anna's involuntary betrayal. The lovers part ways - as they think, forever. Andriy becomes a professional military, while Anna builds a successful career and enjoys married life in Kyiv. Russian aggression changes everything once and for all. Both Andriy and Anna go through pain, suffering, loss of their loved ones, despair and hopelessness. Fate gives them the opportunity to start all over, but will Anna and Andriy manage to forgive past hurts and find love again?

name: Сімейний консультант
summary: The protagonist, a psychologist who has a son with Asperger's syndrome, advises families with children suffering from various forms of autism spectrum disorder. Each episode is a separate story about the search for mutual understanding with a child whose world is very unusual and vulnerable. Such a "prism" reveals problems in the relationships of "normal" people. All the events take place in the midst of russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

name: Мангровий гай
summary: At all times, people are divided into those who do something to change the world around them and those who say there is no point in resisting. A tsunami is an untamable phenomenon. You can build a breakwater, but it will pass by and wash everything away. But when creating the world God gave humanity hope and a way to protect itself against the ocean that can be so destructive... Mangrove. It is a tree that does not have the majesty of an oak or a sequoia. On the contrary, it is a gnarled tree, with crooked, towering roots that rise out of the water. But mangroves are the barrier that saves humanity from the tyranny of tsunamis. At a time when the invasion from russia was about to inevitably crush Ukraine, bleeding and disarmed, ordinary people stood in its way. People who decided that their lives and the future of our country depended on them. They are saving the country, even at the cost of their lives. While the whole world is watching, they are doing the impossible!

name: Продовження роду
summary: According to the plot, four women found themselves in a country maternity hospital on the front line - blocked and under enemy fire. In a previous life, each of them suffered and made the decision to have a child in conditions of personal dilemmas and conflicts. Now they are not only fighting for their own survival, but also for the possibility of giving birth to their children.

name: Курс щасливого життя
summary: Tetyana Krutko, a well-known practicing psychologist with many years of experience, is a new teacher at the Institute of Psychology. She announces recruitment for the practical psychology course. To get to her course is the dream of many students. As a real pro, she likes to solve difficult problems, break stereotypes and teach on cases from real practice. The task of the course is to teach the basics of practical, effective psychology, because this is the first step to solving any life problems. Each lecture of the course is devoted to one specific topic: from the usual - why a personal life does not work out, to the realities dictated by how to survive a loss. The listeners are a group of students. The main thesis of the course: if I'm so smart, why don't I live as I would like?

name: Сховища. Вісім історій
summary: You never know where and when you might face an air raid alarm. These are eight different but incredible stories that would never have happened if the air raid alarm hadn't brought their protagonists together in a shelter. Each episode tells a completely new story with new characters, set in different parts of the country. The only thing all the stories have in common is the air raid alarm, which becomes the starting point of the plot.

name: Батя
summary: "Batya" is a 16-episode detective series about a distinguished operative, Lieutenant Colonel Stepan Trofimovich Bezbateko. After retiring, he hoped for a peaceful life, but his plans were drastically changed by the full-scale Russian invasion. After a year on the front lines and being wounded, Batya returns home. At the request of his daughter Lida, who works as a forensic expert, he agrees to help a young investigator solve a complicated murder case. Batya had no idea that this investigator was his son-in-law. After the truth came to light, the conflicts between the young and ambitious Yulian Synytskyi and the experienced operative only intensified. Will they be able to put their emotions aside to expose the criminals and save their family?

name: Подвійні ставки
summary: The plot centres on the fate of a young man, Igor Shvedov: on the very first day he returns from the front, his elder brother, his only family member, is killed in front of him. But he suddenly learns that his brother was an influential criminal mastermind, and suspects that the people in his circle are not at all who they pretend to be. To find his brother's killer, he joins the police force and begins his war against organised crime and werewolves in uniform...

name: ‎Новорічна шкереберть
summary: On New Year's Eve, in a tiny, cozy hotel in the Carpathians, fate, not without the help of the hotel owner Ivan, brings together very different people. Valera, a soldier of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, goes from the front line to the border to dissuade his wife from getting a divorce. Volunteer Tanya is unsuccessfully trying to raise money for a batch of drones and rushes to customs. Blogger Lisa just wants to live her cloudless and cheerful pre-war life. Deputy Petrovych dreams of escaping abroad with a suitcase of money. They all have very different dreams and views on life, but they will all meet the New Year together to understand what they really expect from the future.

name: Батьківський комітет
summary: The series is about a small town in Ukraine occupied by Russian troops and the struggle of local residents for the future of Ukraine - the protection of young children from forced deportation to the aggressor country.

name: Шлях додому
summary: Trying to sell their grandfather's house, two friends hailing from "gilded youth" become victims of a fraudulent realtor. Two families of migrants fleeing from the war - from Crimea and Donbass - move into the twice-sold house. Completely different mentally, traditionally, and religiously, the families of Crimean Tatars and Ukrainians from Donetsk region are forced to coexist and find out who is in charge of the house. How will the problem with the fraud be resolved, will the two different families be able to live together, and will their domestic quarrels amid talk of a possible Russian invasion of Ukraine interfere with the emergence and flourishing of love between their children?

name: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World
summary: Togo Asagaki was the Red Ranger in a heroic Ranger squad. During their final battle against an evil organization, he gave his life to guarantee their triumph. But fate had other plans, and he found himself reborn in an entirely different world. Embracing his new role as an adventurer, he transforms into Kizuna Red and continues his pursuit of justice, helping those in need

name: Momentary Lily
summary: Robotic invaders wiped out all life, but Renge fights to survive using her powers. With no memories, she roams the city until she meets five other young women, each with unique abilities. Together, they make the most of their lives, cooking delicious meals between battles with mechanical monstrosities. As they uncover the secrets of their powers and pasts, they find strength in their friendship.

name: ОПГ
summary: Ukraine is striving to become a part of the European Union, sharing European values and standards of state structure. In order to improve the overall culture and efficiency of the police, Ukraine is conducting an experiment: a special operational and demonstration group (OG) is being created in the bowels of the Kyiv Police Department.

name: Whiskey on the Rocks
summary: In the middle of the Cold War, a Soviet submarine runs aground outside Karlskrona and suddenly Sweden finds itself at the center of events. Prime Minister Thorbjörn Fälldin tries to resolve the conflict and avoid a world war between two nuclear powers while struggling with a wise foreign minister and a belligerent commander-in-chief.

name: Molly-Mae: Behind it All
summary: A raw and intimate docu-series following Britain's biggest influencer, Molly-Mae Hague. With unprecedented access to Molly and her family in the months after the break-up that shook the world, we follow her as she launches her clothing brand and navigates life as a single Mum. Strong, vulnerable and driven, the series reveals a different side to Molly-Mae.

name: Live From E!
summary: Having been a "Friend of 7Bravo" since February 2023 and familiar face on Australian television, Bella will now be front and centre at Australia's biggest awards shows and fashion events, showcasing all the red-carpet glamour and hosting celebrity interviews with Live From E! on 7Bravo.

name: Christmas with Delta
summary: Don't miss this festive celebration with Delta Goodrem as she brings her annual Christmas show to life with friends old and new.

name: Single Bells
summary: In this heartwarming Christmas comedy, eternally single Mina lets her family find her a date so she won't be alone this Christmas. Who will sit next to her at Christmas dinner?

name: Michael Lynn - The Fugitive
summary:
New RTÉ Documentary Michael Lynn: The Fugitive asks where did the money go?

One of the loose ends that still exists with the Michael Lynn story is the question of what happened with the money. Virtually none of which has been recovered. When solicitor Michael Lynn fled Ireland in December 2007, he'd clocked up €80m in loans from high street banks, much of them fraudulently secured via multiple mortgages. And he owed another €12m to private investors who had paid out for unbuilt apartments abroad.

A new two-part documentary series beginning on RTÉ One and RTÉ Player tonight, highlights new links involving a Bulgarian business associate of Michael Lynn's setting up companies in Ireland relating to property development, and those company accounts being accessed by Mr Lynn's wife, Brid Murphy withdrawing cash in the last year. 

Michael Lynn: The Fugitive reveals the true story of an epic hunt to bring one of Ireland's most notorious fugitives to justice told directly by the reporter who tracked him down, his victims, and former employees. The two-part series is directed by Trevor Birney and produced by Fine Point Films for RTÉ.

Irish Mail on Sunday Journalist Michael O'Farrell and photographer Sean Dwyer ended up hunting Michael Lynn down all over the world, from Portugal to Bulgaria to a hellhole prison in Brazil. Michael Lynn was facing serious questions about his fraudulent actions in Ireland when he fled to Portugal. They spotted someone tearing up documents and leaving them outside Lynn's offices in Portugal one night. When they got them back to the hotel and pieced them together, it was a treasure trove of information on Lynn. They had discovered a cache of discarded documents in Portugal which led them deeper into Lynn's labyrinth of lies.
